info.title: Bounty
info.description: Read whether buying at a store pays the shopper a reward, from the store's own published Open Bounty Schema declaration. For agent platforms that build a connector from API documentation. The same action is available as an MCP tool at https://api.nctr.live/mcp/bounty.

get.description: Runs the discovery walk against the store's own domain (/.well-known/bounty.json, then <link rel="bounty">), validates the object against the live schema, verifies a signature when present, and returns the earn.display sentence to show verbatim and the resolved object. "unknown" means the store publishes nothing; it does not mean purchases earn nothing. Read-only.

parameters.name: product
parameters.description: An https product page URL on that domain, to check the product-page carriers too

200.description: The check result. status is valid, invalid or unknown.

earn_display.description: The store's sentence, to show verbatim

object.description: The resolved Open Bounty Schema object

400.description: Not a store's public hostname, or a product URL on another domain

429.description: Rate limited; retry after a minute

503.description: The schema couldn't be loaded; nothing was checked
